summary: Rectangular perforated universal mounting plate with a regular grid of 3 mm holes on a 5 mm pitch, used as a robot chassis base. One plate from a 2-piece set.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top face of the plate, with the perforated grid for mounting components
Bottom face of the plate, with the same perforated grid

notes: The 160 x 60 mm outline, the 3 mm hole diameter, the 5 mm pitch and the 11 x 31 grid come from the unverified product spec, not from a printed drawing. The images show no dimensions for the plate itself. The 2 mm thickness is a placeholder because no thickness is stated. The listed hole positions are only the four corner holes of the grid, which spans 150 x 50 mm. The full pattern is 31 columns along x (-75 to 75 mm) by 11 rows along y (-25 to 25 mm), at 5 mm steps, centered on the plate. The product photo may show a different hole count than the spec. The edge tabs on the plate are not dimensioned, so they are not included in the bounds. The angle brackets, shaft mounts and push rivets in the set are separate parts and are not modeled here.
